blocker: The persisted public-index frontier pass exhausted exact-date public search/PDF-reference discovery with zero candidate live Savills URLs. Its next_safe_route explicitly required mining public auction-result sources for exact property address/postcode clues, but no executable address-led recovery stage existed and the archival workflow did not run the existing public-index recovery stage either. Therefore an hourly pass could terminate after first-party/Common Crawl probing without executing the persisted next route.

repair.acceptance_rule: No public/aggregator page is accepted as canonical evidence. It may only supply an address/postcode or historical reference used to discover a candidate; recover_candidate must validate a surviving Savills-owned page, auction date and commercial/mixed-use eligibility before persistence.
